text: Entry 893 creates a temporary comm/package.json so an upstream ESLint helper sees a Node project. Context-only entry 949 removes that workaround, and the accepted commlint wrapper no longer writes or unlinks that file. Its pushd helper restores the working directory in finally. Do not copy the historical package overwrite into new lint entry points. The old file cleanup was after the normal return path rather than protected by finally; no exception or data-loss experiment was run.
title: Keep a removed lint workaround out of new wrapper code
